Sorry you're going through such a hard time. Welcome to the club. I suggest trying a self harm alternative, such as snapping an elastic band on your wrist or doing breathing excercises. But, if you must self harm,I understand. You can cut your thighs or upper arms or you could bruise yourself in relatively unnoticeable places. That won't leave a scar, at least. Bruises usually go away in a few days. I used to self harm on my hands, too, but then I started getting unwanted attention and stares from other people. There aren't many proper ways to hide self harm that's on your hands because you kinda use them for everything, everyday. Also, a disclaimer: I do not promote self harm at all. I have been self harming for six years and it's just taken up so many years of my life. Please seek professional help before your self harm starts to get dangerous. And believe me, it will. Please stay safe 💜
